calculation.expression: -((asset_return_1d - cross_sectional_median_return_1d) / rolling_20d_std(asset_return_1d - cross_sectional_median_return_1d)) conditioned on cross-sectional MAD dispersion above its trailing 60-day 70th percentile
calculation.description: When cross-asset return dispersion is unusually high, rank assets by reversal of their one-day return residual versus the cross-sectional median, normalized by 20-day residual volatility. Higher values indicate stronger expected next-day rebound.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across reported 2020-22, 2023-24, 2025-26 and Jul-2026 to Feb-2027 subperiod slices; active dates are dispersion-conditioned and therefore coverage is selective. Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative interpretation.
